svg.title: RustSys: Verilog to gate-level netlist
svg.desc: A clock-enabled eight-bit AND in Verilog maps to an AND, feedback multiplexer and flip-flop bank. Animated pulses describe data flow; this is an illustration, not a run or proof result.
svg.text: rustsys synth --top enabled_and --lib cells.lib --out gates.v enabled_and.v
